newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB launches new gas turbine.
newsitem.headline: ABB launches new gas turbine.

text.p: Electrical engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said it was introducing the GTX 100, a new, compact 43-megawatt advanced industrial gas turbine.

ABB said the turbine was targetted at cogeneration of heat and power and particularly combined-cycle operations for which its performance was optimised to achieve increased power output and efficiency of 54 percent.
The new turbine completes the product line between ABB's 25 megawatt GT10 and the 53 megawatt GT8C gas turbines.
The first GTX100 turbines are scheduled to enter into service at the start of 1999.
The world market for 40-50 megawatt sized gas turbines amounts to 4-5,000 megawatt per year and has been steadily increasing.

The market includes independent power producers (IPPs) and small utilities, but is dominated by process industy customers, such as mining, metals, cement, and particularly the oil, gas, petrochemical and chemical industries, who often need process steam in addition to power.
